label: Hook-owned project fee
summary: Add a disclosed hook-owned project fee without inventing a separate platform-fee requirement.
requiredFacts: Selected project fee, basis and its relationship to any separately selected platform fee
Project beneficiary, mutation rules, liability keys and claim behavior
Executed gross quote-side basis, rounding and partial-fill behavior
Public fee disclosure for every trading surface
requiredTests: Project fee behavior at zero, minimum, ordinary and maximum selected rates
Any separately selected platform fee composes without double collection
Beneficiary mutation cannot redirect another selected recipient share
risks: Additive implementation can charge more than the disclosed total
Mutable recipients can create undisclosed payout control
